newsitem.title: USA: Ackerley sets two-for-one stock split.
newsitem.headline: Ackerley sets two-for-one stock split.

text.p: Ackerley Communications Inc said Monday its board of directors has approved a two-for-one stock split of its common and class B common stock.
The split will be effective on October 15 for stockholders of record on October 4. The split is subject to shareholder approval of an increase in the number of class B shares authorized.
Ackerley said in a statement that Barry Ackerley, chairman and chief executive officer, who holds more than a majority of the outstanding votes, will provide the shareholder approval.
Ackerley is a multimedia, advertising sales business, with interests in outdoor advertising, airport displays, broadcasting and professional sports.
Shares of Ackerley closed at 29-1/4 on the American Stock Exchange.
